Second is **layout conversion overhead**: 472 of 928 tensor links between kernels need re-arrangement, mostly for head-dimension changes. Third are **ISA gaps**: 49 operations across several categories (conv2d, runtime-index addressing, cumsum, upsample, and others) lack chip support and must fall back to replacements, though these replacements cost 0 cycles and 0 dB. Fourth, **resource limits** show 1380 operations relying on a 256-entry LUT, with no IMEM overuse or FP32 headroom issues. Notably, no compute-efficiency measurements exist yet, and all what-if analyses show zero MAC or accuracy recovery, suggesting the ISA-gap replacements are already cost-neutral.
